units.source_text: 表妹想把我脱下的那件汗湿的和服，拿到向阳的廊道上晾晒。

en.t: My cousin wanted to take the sweat-soaked kimono I had taken off and hang it out to dry in the sunny corridor.

units.source_text: 她像是嗅到汗臭似的，皱皱眉头给我看，兴冲冲地跟我开玩笑说：

en.t: As if she had caught the smell of sweat, she wrinkled her nose for me to see and cheerfully teased me, saying:
